C0110.title: ABS Pump Motor Circuit Malfunction
C0110.description: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the hydraulic pump motor circuit. The pump rebuilds brake pressure during ABS regulation — without it, ABS and stability control are disabled.

causes.label: ABS pump motor failed (worn brushes, seized)
Power supply wiring or fuse fault

C0111.title: ABS Activation Excessively Long
C0111.description: ABS regulation has been active longer than the allowed duration during a single brake event, suggesting a sensor or hydraulic problem.

C0112.title: ABS Activation Frequency Too High
C0112.description: ABS regulation cycles activate more frequently than the plausibility model allows.

C0121.title: Valve Relay Circuit Malfunction
C0121.description: The ABS control module has detected a fault in the valve relay circuit, which supplies power to the ABS solenoid valves. With this fault, the module cannot energize the valves and ABS is disabled.

causes.label: Power supply wiring or fuse fault

C0128.title: Low Brake Fluid Indicated
C0128.description: The brake fluid level switch in the master cylinder reservoir reports a low level. ABS and stability control may be deactivated as a precaution.

causes.label: Worn brake pads (fluid drops as pistons extend)

C0131.title: Master Cylinder Pressure Sensor Range/Performance
C0131.description: The ABS or stability control module has detected an implausible signal from the master cylinder brake pressure sensor. This sensor reports driver brake input and is used by ABS and ESP for control decisions.

causes.label: Air in brake system causing erratic pressure

C0136.title: Stop Lamp Switch Circuit
C0136.description: The ABS or stability control module sees an implausible brake light switch signal. Stability and brake assist functions can be limited until the fault is cleared.

C0141.title: Left Front ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit
C0141.description: Left Front ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.

causes.label: Inlet solenoid coil open or shorted

C0146.title: Left Front ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit
C0146.description: Left Front ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.

causes.label: Outlet solenoid coil open or shorted

C0148.title: Right Front ABS Outlet Solenoid B Circuit Malfunction
C0148.description: The ABS module has detected an electrical fault in the secondary outlet solenoid for the right front wheel. ABS and stability control are disabled while the fault is active.

causes.label: Outlet solenoid valve failed (open or shorted)
Internal fault in ABS hydraulic unit

C0151.title: Right Front ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit
C0151.description: Right Front ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.

causes.label: Inlet solenoid coil open or shorted

C0153.title: Right Front ABS Inlet Solenoid B Circuit Malfunction
C0153.description: Electrical fault in the secondary inlet solenoid for the right front wheel. Pressure modulation for that wheel is no longer possible and ABS is disabled.

C0156.title: Right Front ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit
C0156.description: Right Front ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit: an electrical fault is present in the circuit.

causes.label: Outlet solenoid coil open or shorted

C0158.title: Left Rear ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit Malfunction
C0158.description: Electrical fault in the inlet solenoid for the left rear wheel. ABS is disabled and the warning lamp is illuminated.

C0161.title: ABS/TCS Brake Switch Circuit
C0161.description: The ABS or traction control module has detected an implausible signal from the brake light switch. The switch tells the module whether the driver is braking and is used to inhibit traction control during braking.

causes.label: Brake light switch failed or misadjusted

C0163.title: Left Rear ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit Malfunction
C0163.description: Electrical fault in the outlet solenoid for the left rear wheel. ABS pressure release for this wheel is no longer possible.

C0168.title: Right Rear ABS Inlet Solenoid Circuit Malfunction
C0168.description: Electrical fault in the inlet solenoid for the right rear wheel. ABS is disabled while the fault is active.

C0173.title: Right Rear ABS Outlet Solenoid Circuit Malfunction
C0173.description: Electrical fault in the outlet solenoid for the right rear wheel. ABS pressure release for this wheel is no longer possible.

C0185.title: Lateral Acceleration Sensor Range/Performance
C0185.description: The stability control module has detected that the lateral acceleration sensor signal is out of the expected range or does not match other inertial sensors. ESP and roll-stability functions may be disabled.

causes.label: Lateral acceleration sensor failed or drifted
Sensor mounting loose or misaligned after body repair

C0186.title: Lateral Acceleration Sensor Circuit
C0186.description: The stability control module has detected an implausible signal from the lateral acceleration sensor. ESP uses lateral g-force together with yaw rate and steering angle to detect skid conditions — without it, ESP is disabled.

causes.label: Sensor cluster loose or mounted incorrectly

C0196.title: Yaw Rate Sensor Circuit
C0196.description: The stability control module has detected an implausible signal from the yaw rate sensor. The yaw sensor measures rotation around the vertical axis and is essential for ESP — a fault disables stability control.

causes.label: Sensor not calibrated after replacement or alignment
